verdict.description: pass = all ACs verified and no critical/high findings; fail = reproducible defect found; blocked = environment broken or verification impossible

id.description: AC id from the ticket, e.g. AC-1

evidence.description: What was directly observed: steps taken, values seen, artifact path

covering_test.description: Required when the evidence substitutes a scenario for the AC's literal one (different filter, counts, or data shape): the id of the green tier-1 test that asserts the literal case. Omit it when you exercised the literal scenario yourself.

repro_steps.description: Exact numbered steps a human can follow to reproduce

summary.description: 3-6 sentence human-readable summary of what was tested and the outcome
